title: Creations Of Tygrys
description: Mod made for fun, adding new boss, dimension and structures!
body:
![Creations Of Tygrys Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2ce345d7db8e77a263c0bff5e30e3c06c35b9fc6.png) I made this mod for fun, it adds: - The Eye Boss - Eyefull Zombies - EyeLand dimension - Two Biomes that appear in the EyeLand - Eyestone and Eyestone Ores - Eyeonite Ore, Weapons, Tools and Armor - Iris Acid and Iris Acid Lakes - Concentrator block that gives redstone energy depending on the Power inside it. - Eye Wood and Eye Wood blocks
Images Eyestone and Eyestone Ores: ![Eyestone and Eyestone Ores Image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/207fabfda503e3743f6797025871a05de705cf9d_0.webp) Eye Wood and Eye Wood Blocks: ![Eye Wood and Eyewood Blocks Image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/af4b4e872e2fca297af3c49f4c95d52176514c5c_0.webp) Concentrator and Concentrator GUI: ![Concentrator Image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/58e93d6aa2bc920af6686ec4734e71f1dff1773b_0.webp) ![Concentrator GUI Image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/80d8e1f1415a72dd373b446be3ebab572e79fee6.png) EyeLand: ![EyeLand First Image](https://i.imgur.com/Xwehalw.jpeg) ![EyeLand Second Image](https://i.imgur.com/NJerVnC.jpeg) ![EyeLand Third Image](https://i.imgur.com/GlJ9BdK.jpeg)
All Images were made using [Solar Shaders](https://modrinth.com/shader/solas-shader)!
